'''Christinus Force Drain By Death''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list [[Christinus]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13dark.htm Force Drain By Death], The Outer Rim (Christinus). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030143204/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13dark.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Christinus]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Force Drain By Death''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empires New Order|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE ISB Christinus DS 2001 OuterRim.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Force Drain By Death

== Introduction ==

Christinus posted this ISB Operations list on The Outer Rim as Force Drain By Death. The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

<blockquote>
To start off the game use ISB Operations and Pull out Coruscant. Now use Twi'lek Advisor to pull out the effect that is the most appropriate.
</blockquote>
